search_perplexity_search: search using the Perplexity API with an API key, query string, and result count to return SearchResult objects
filter_perplexity_results: filter Perplexity search results by a list of allowed domains using the filter_list parameter
forward_user_headers_perplexity: forward user info headers to the Perplexity API by passing a user object to include_user_info_headers
parse_perplexity_response: parse the Perplexity API JSON response and extract url, title, and snippet fields into SearchResult objects
handle_persistent_config_perplexity: handle PersistentConfig objects by converting api_key and api_url to strings before API calls
